_note: SYNTHETIC sample emails written for this demo. Names, people, vendors, productions, prices and approval numbers are made up. Not Sadaf data. 'expected' is the hand-written right answer used by python -m odoo_agent eval; 'production' there is the code it should resolve to ('unsure' = the email names it too vaguely, so the agent must not be sure and a person picks; null = the email does not name one, so the sender is asked).

samples.subject: Crane rental for Rimal Al-Khobar

Thanks,
Noura Al-Harbi
Production Department
